name: carelink-doctor-platform
description: CareLink doctor services for the Smart Medical and Elderly Care Platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @doctor/web && npm run build -w @doctor/api && npm run build -w @doctor/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @doctor/api && npm run test -w @doctor/desktop
scripts.check: npm run check:boundaries && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev:web: concurrently --kill-others --names API,WEB --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run dev -w @doctor/api" "npm run dev -w @doctor/web"
scripts.package:win: npm run build && node scripts/package-desktop.mjs nsis
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && node scripts/package-desktop.mjs dir
